snippet.title: Korea's Paper-Cart Collectors
snippet.description:
A 62-year-old retired house painter in Seoul owns exactly one thing, according to the two reporters who followed him: an empty steel cart that weighs 79 kilos, about 174 pounds. He uses it to collect cardboard, which scrapyards buy by the kilo. Korea's government estimated about 42,000 old people were doing this in 2023, average age 76, working mostly before dawn, in the street. Most said they needed the money to live, and one in 16 had been hit in traffic while collecting. At the scale, the reporters wrote, the weigh-in is "as strict as a boxer's." When a grandmother slipped her foot onto the platform, the owner snapped, "Grandma, are you kidding? Get off." She whispered, "It'd only be another 1,000 won."

The reporters tried it themselves: 10 hours, 232 kilos (about 500 pounds), and 10,000 won, roughly $8.50. Their blister ointment the next day cost 5,000. At another yard, a woman in her eighties told them, "I pick all day and still can't properly eat a 3,000-won bowl of noodles, so I often go hungry." One September 2026 morning, an 80-year-old pushing a converted baby stroller made 3,700 won (about $2.72), the day's money for her and the two grandsons she has raised since her son died. Almost all of them worked for decades. In the government's survey, 86% had jobs before 65, for an average of 24 years, but only a quarter get a pension from that work. 93% rely on Korea's Basic Pension, which in 2023 paid at most about 323,000 won a month, around $250. The cart fills the gap between that and rent.

The painter lives on welfare, but it isn't nearly enough to feed him, and any money he earns can get his welfare cut. So he collects cardboard without reporting the income. "I do a little on the sly," he told the reporters. One startup in Seoul actually builds lighter carts for collectors. A normal cart weighs about 75 kilos, and the startup got theirs down to 38. It stopped there, because its founder says "a cart that is too light breaks."

snippet.title: ¿Qué pasa realmente cuando te crujes los nudillos?  #3d #cuerpohumano  #curiosidades #ciencia
snippet.description:
¿Por qué al crujirse los nudillos escuchas ese sonido característico? Descubre el proceso físico detrás de este fenómeno.

El acto de crujirse los nudillos es un proceso conocido médicamente como cavitación. Cuando las superficies de tus articulaciones se separan, la presión interna disminuye drásticamente, permitiendo que se forme una cavidad de gas.

Este proceso ocurre en una fracción de segundo, generando el sonido articular que escuchas al realizar este movimiento. Entender este fenómeno es clave para conocer mejor la mecánica corporal de tu organismo.

snippet.title: Spanish Model BUSTED in Vietnam (8 Years for One Night!)
snippet.description:
Spanish model An Tây got 8 years in Vietnam after a drug case tied to her Ho Chi Minh City apartment.

But why did she go to prison when four Vietnam Airlines flight attendants carrying 11+ kilos were never charged?

Andrea Aybar Carmona, better known in Vietnam as An Tây, was a model, actress, TV personality and social-media creator with millions of followers. Then a police investigation, drugs inside her apartment, other people using them, and one critical Vietnamese legal concept changed everything. 

Attorney Ken Duong breaks down how Vietnam’s Article 255, “organizing the illegal use of narcotics,” can turn what someone might casually describe as a “private party” into a serious criminal case, and what foreigners need to understand about Vietnam’s laws before they decide to live in Vietnam, work in Vietnam, or enjoy its nightlife.

We also examine the disputed ketamine evidence, why prosecutors wanted a longer sentence, how An Tây’s case differed from the Vietnam Airlines flight attendants, and what foreigners in Vietnam should understand before assuming that something happening inside a private apartment stays “private.” 

From drug-related offenses and illegal parties to police investigations and prison sentences, Vietnam has laws that every expat, tourist, and foreign resident should understand. Whether you are planning to travel to Vietnam, move to Ho Chi Minh City, or live in Vietnam long-term, knowing the law can help you avoid costly and potentially life-changing mistakes.

The world's shortest flight spans just 1.7 miles between two islands in Scotland. It takes less time than taxiing at a major hub.

The route connects Westray and Papa Westray within the Orkney Islands. Operating continuously since 1967, this unique service serves as a vital link for the local community rather than just a tourist novelty.

To put the scale into perspective, this journey is shorter than the longest runway at JFK Airport. While modern commercial aviation usually focuses on long-haul efficiency, this specific route highlights the necessity of traditional travel methods in remote regions. snippet.title: EU activa alerta de tsunami en México por terremoto de 7.2 en Panamá
snippet.description:
Un potente terremoto de magnitud 7.2 sacudió Panamá este viernes, provocando la intervención de autoridades de monitoreo marítimo internacionales.   

Organismos de Estados Unidos activaron la alerta de tsunami e incluyeron las costas mexicanas dentro de las zonas bajo posible amenaza.   

La advertencia emitida por las instituciones estadounidenses alcanza también a países como Costa Rica, Colombia, Ecuador, Perú, Guatemala, Nicaragua y El Salvador.   

Autoridades y organismos especializados mantienen vigilancia constante ante posibles cambios en el nivel del mar y oleaje alto.   

Se exhorta a la población costera a mantenerse atenta a la información oficial y evitar acercarse a las playas.

snippet.title: തനി നാടൻ നെയ്യ് വീട്ടിൽ തന്നെ!🧈😋🔥 Homemade Ghee #ghee #gheerecipe #homemadeghee #keralafood #malabar
snippet.description:
Ingredients

- Thick cream collected from boiled milk — 1 kg
- Water — 2–3 cups, as required
- Cold water — as required for washing the butter

How to Prepare

1. Collect the thick cream that forms on top of boiled milk and store it in the refrigerator until you have enough cream.
2. Transfer the collected cream into a clean jar.
3. Add some water to the cream and blend/grind it well until the butter separates from the buttermilk.
4. Once the butter has separated, collect the butter and remove it from the buttermilk.
5. Wash the separated butter thoroughly with clean cold water to remove any remaining buttermilk.
6. Once the butter is clean, transfer it to a saucepan.
7. Place the saucepan over low flame and slowly melt the butter.
8. Keep heating it gently over low flame, allowing the butter to melt gradually without burning.
9. Continue cooking slowly until the melted butter separates into clear golden ghee and milk solids.
10. Keep it on low flame until the ghee becomes beautifully clear and golden, while the milk solids turn light golden brown.
11. Turn off the flame and allow the ghee to cool slightly.
12. Strain the ghee through a fine sieve or clean muslin cloth to remove the milk solids.
13. Transfer the strained ghee into a completely clean and dry glass jar.
14. Allow it to cool completely before closing the jar and storing it.
.

নাটকের প্রধান দিকসমূহ:

আর্থিক সংকট ও অপমান: রাতুলের বাবা দীর্ঘদিনের চাকরি হারিয়ে বেকার হয়ে পড়েন, যার ফলে পরিবারের দৈনন্দিন খরচ চালানো অসম্ভব হয়ে পড়ে। বাড়িওয়ালার ক্রমাগত অপমান এবং হুমকির মুখে তাদের জীবন অসহনীয় হয়ে ওঠে (41:00 - 43:10)।

অপূর্ণ প্রেম: ঋতুর সাথে রাতুলের সম্পর্কের জটিলতা প্রকট হয়ে ওঠে যখন ঋতুর বিয়ের সিদ্ধান্ত হয়। রাতুল নিজেকে ঋতুর জন্য একটি 'ভুল মানুষ' হিসেবে দাবি করে, কারণ সে তখনো নিজের জীবনের ভিত্তি মজবুত করতে পারেনি (36:00 - 37:40)।

সামাজিক বাস্তবতা: নাটকটি এই শহরের নিষ্ঠুর বাস্তবতাকে তুলে ধরে, যেখানে অভাবের কারণে অনেক স্বপ্ন বিসর্জন দিতে হয়। রাতুলের বোনও পিকনিকে যাওয়ার ইচ্ছা পূরণ করতে পারে না, যা পরিবারের পরিস্থিতির প্রতিফলন ঘটায় (4:05 - 5:50)।

Tina is treated like an outsider in her own home by her mother-in-law and sister-in-law, Linda. 😢 When Tina arrives at the family dinner, she is told to sit in the kitchen because there is supposedly no room for her at the table. But when they need her help with household chores, suddenly she becomes part of the family again!
Things get even more frustrating when her mother-in-law interrupts an important client call, orders her to wash clothes in the rain, and expects her to prepare breakfast at 5 AM. But Tina finally decides to stand up for herself and refuses to accept the unfair treatment anymore! 😲
Will Tina's family finally understand the importance of respect and equality? Or will the family conflict get even worse?

He then describes how the criminal proceedings, imprisonment and loss of work changed his life, and why he eventually felt discarded by someone he once considered so close.

The conversation also includes his recollections of Sunil Dutt, the assistance he credits to Maanyata Dutt, life in prison and the faith that helped him through difficult years.

- Their friendship before Sanjay became a Bollywood star
- His experiences with Sunil Dutt and Maanyata Dutt
- The impact on his work, relationships and personal life
- Why he says he would still help a friend despite everything

A conversation about friendship, accountability and the consequences of a decision that changed more than one life.
